0.intro: The EV3 brick must be registered with your {platform} once before Pybricks can see it. It's like exchanging phone numbers. You need to do this only once. After that, you can connect here in Pybricks any time.
0.message: On your EV3, go to {settings} and choose {registerDevice}. Leave the EV3 on this screen.

1.message: Open the Bluetooth settings on your {platform} and turn Bluetooth on. {findDevice}
1.disconnect: Once complete, your EV3 brick will disconnect automatically. This is intentional. Close the Bluetooth settings on your {platform} and on your EV3. Now you can connect with the Bluetooth button in Pybricks whenever your EV3 is turned on.

0.intro: The NXT brick must be registered with your {platform} once before Pybricks can see it. It's like exchanging phone numbers. You need to do this only once. After that, you can connect here in Pybricks any time.

1.message: Open the Bluetooth settings on your {platform} and turn Bluetooth on. {findDevice} When you are asked for a passkey, enter {passkey}{suggestedPasskeyNote}.
1.suggestedPasskeyNote: , replacing any code that your computer filled in for you. That field is editable, even though it may not look like it
1.disconnect: Once complete, your NXT brick will disconnect automatically. This is intentional. Close the Bluetooth settings on your {platform}. Now you can connect with the Bluetooth button in Pybricks whenever your NXT is turned on.

2.listedWithWarning: If it is listed with a warning sign, right-click it and select {properties}.
2.listedWithoutWarning: If it is listed somewhere else without a warning sign, then the driver is already installed. You may close this window.
2.notListed: If you don't see it at all, make sure that the hub is in DFU update mode and try again. Close this window to watch the video instructions.

3.message: In the {properties} dialog, click the {updateDriver} button.

7.message: In the {manufacturer} list, select {winUsbDevice}. Then in the {model} list, also select {winUsbDevice}. Then click the {next} button.

9.message: The driver installation is complete. Click the {close} button.
